title: Phandalin · Outside Barthen’s Provisions

sourceRecords.title: 1 · Outside Barthen’s Provisions
read: The road ends in a street of packed earth and old stone. A trading house stands ahead, its doorway busy with local customers. Sildar slows beside you and studies the town as if trying to remember the face of an old friend. Gundren should have been here before you. He is not. What do you do?

The trading house offers an obvious place to ask questions or settle the delivery, while the street leaves you free to keep walking. Its traffic is ordinary enough that you can watch the doorway, approach together, or decide who will speak before going inside.

sourceRecords.title: Opening · Barthen’s Provisions
read: The noise of Phandalin follows you to Barthen’s door: cart wheels on packed earth, a hammer somewhere farther down the street, and voices turning toward the day’s business. Gundren is at an inn behind you. Glasstaff is gone. The shop is here in front of you. What do you do?

The shop's threshold is close enough to cross, but you have not yet chosen to enter. You can begin with town business, turn back toward the inn, or stop to discuss the rat in Trista's care. For now, the street leaves each of those choices open.
